behaviors.assignee-options: Opening the Assignee filter shows Anyone, each person, and Unassigned with current task counts.
behaviors.search-assignees: Typing in Find a person narrows the assignee options.
behaviors.combined-filters: Selecting Priya while To do is selected shows only Priya’s To do tasks.
behaviors.unassigned-filter: Selecting Unassigned shows the unassigned task.
behaviors.unassigned-person-empty-state: Selecting Ana shows “Nothing assigned to Ana Lima yet” with a Clear filters control.
behaviors.clear-filters: Clear filters restores All statuses and Anyone, bringing back all tasks.

history.notes: The tour uses the toolbar’s status select and the Assignee listbox to avoid similarly named controls on task cards and in the dialog. Counts and task names come from the supplied seed data.
